plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Moxa EDS industrial switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, power input status, and interface traffic, based on the EDS-408A MIB (enterprise PEN 8691).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU load of the Moxa EDS industrial switch over the past 5 seconds in percent (MOXA-EDS408A-MIB cpuLoading5s scalar).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Moxa EDS industrial switch in percent (MOXA-EDS408A-MIB memoryUsage scalar).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: State of power input 1 of the Moxa EDS industrial switch (MOXA-EDS408A-MIB power1InputStatus), normalised to 1=present / 2=not present.

metrics.name: device_psu_state_backup
metrics.description: State of power input 2 of the Moxa EDS industrial switch (MOXA-EDS408A-MIB power2InputStatus), normalised to 1=present / 2=not present.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
